voyage.text: Have a good trip. I'll take good care of the sundial.
Thank you! We'll help the next island too, for sure!
Next is Curie Island. They say it welcomes the boats with a rainbow light every night.
Huh? It's so dark. I can't see any rainbow light at all.
That's strange. The lighthouse must have gone out.
Oh, a boat! A boat came! How did you find us with no light?

prologue.text: Hi! We came from Hutton Island. We barely made it by following the starlight. Who are you?
I'm Yaongi! I'm the keeper of the lighthouse up on that hill.
But a few days ago the lighthouse light began to fade, and last night it went out completely. I went up and there wasn't a single crystal lens piece.
A crystal lens gathers a small light and sends it far out over the sea. Without the lens, the boats can't find the island.
I think the sea wind blew them away. I saw something sparkling in Kitchen Village, in Spring Village, and all over this hill.
The lighthouse is out, so the boats can't come. We're running out of salt, flour and drinking water.
If the boats lose their way, it's a big problem… You must have felt so sad all alone.
But why did the lens pieces come off?
I don't know. I polished it until it sparkled every day… Maybe there was some red powder on the lens rim.
Don't worry. We'll find all the pieces and light the lighthouse again! Until then, let's make what you need together.
Really? Wow, I'm so excited! I'll show you the way. Let's start with Kitchen Village!
